text:
mira: Heads-up — Sapphire Analytics (acct SA-379) has an overdue balance for INV-0003782: $48,200. They replied to our dunning and are asking to settle: 40% now, remainder split over 4 months. CC retry failed. Need guidance: accept their plan (we'd mark as final settlement) or escalate to collections/legal?

billing-bot: Automated dunning email step 3 sent to billing contact sapphire@analytics.co — follow-up scheduled in 72h. CC auth decline on last retry.

kai: Do we have the usage breakdown for that invoice? any spikes that look like test env or onboarding mistakes?

mira: quick breakdown pasted below:
```
INV-0003782 lines:
- Core subscription (annual): $12,000
- Usage overage (inference tokens / embeddings): $36,200
- Credits/discounts applied: $0
Total: $48,200
```

kai: Overage is large. Do we have an eval/runbook showing those tokens came from prod traffic? if it's a misconfigured ingestion we'd push for reversal.

omar: I pulled logs — looks like a sustained batch job starting 2025-11-02 that drove traffic. Contact says they migrated a partner feed that was supposed to be throttled. Could argue partial credit but not full.

sasha: Given amount > $25k, collections policy says we can offer payment plan but any >30% permanent reduction needs revops/exec approval or legal signoff. We should also require a signed settlement addendum if we accept less than full.

mira: cc @jules for approval to accept 40% immediate + 4 monthly payments as final settlement subject to signed addendum. Also note CC failed; recommend ACH link or wire.

trevor: From legal — we're okay with a settlement addendum template. Need it to include: confirmation of debt, payment schedule, no further disputes, and a clause that missed installment reverts to full balance due. I can draft.

jules: I need one quick datapoint before approving: what's the expected recovery vs. time/cost of collections? If we offer 40% now and they pay the plan, is it materially better than opening a collections case?

omar: Conservative estimate: collections recover ~35-55% over 6–9 months but with legal/coll costs and longer time to cash. Accepting 40% now + plan nets faster cash and avoids churn risk.

jules: ok — approve conditional settlement. Conditions: (1) 40% wired/ACH within 7 business days, (2) signed settlement addendum (trevor to attach), (3) auto-escalate to collections if any installment misses >5 days. Mira, please send ACH link and the addendum template.

mira: Roger. I'll send the ACH/payment link and the Trevor draft. Will mark thread as Escalation->Collections if they don't sign/pay by deadline.

mira: (to client) Sending offer: 40% immediate via ACH or wire + remaining balance in 4 equal monthly installments; must sign settlement addendum. Please confirm by EOD.

billing-bot: Payment link generated: https://payments.redwood.ai/pay/SA-379/INV-0003782 — expires in 7 days.

sapphire-contact (external): Thanks — our CFO is reviewing. Can you extend to 10 days and accept initial 30%? We'll try to push to 40% but need internal signoff.

mira: Noted. Per Jules, we need 40% within 7 days for the conditional approval. If they can do 30% today plus 10% within 10 days we can consider, but final approval requires the signed addendum and jules signoff.

jules: I can flex to 30% immediate + 10% in 10 days ONLY if they sign the addendum and we get the 30% today. Otherwise stick to 40%/7 days.

mira: Thanks — I'll loop client and update thread when payment lands.

trevor: Drafted addendum uploaded to /legal/settlements/templates/ — will DM the doc to Mira.

mira: Closing note: setting reminder for follow-up 7 days from now. If no payment, escalate to collections.

sasha: Adding a note to the account — flag for 90-day review if they complete plan.

mira: Updated — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
